idea-plugin.name: .NET EOL & CRA Support Window Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Dates every target framework in a .csproj against Microsoft's end-of-support day and against the support period you promise

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → .NET EOL & CRA Support Window Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 10 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/dotnet-eol-support-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/dotnet-eol-support-gate
